_comment: Components of a control's expected state the assessment does not establish, whatever the tenant looks like: the evaluator does not read that evidence. Every surface that shows the control also shows 'Not established: <component>.', so a reader cannot take the verified half for the whole requirement. docs/TP-DETECTION-LIMITS.md explains each entry; add an entry here in the same change as the limitation, and remove it in the same change as the read that lifts it. Empty since 2026-10-14: INT-1.1's non-compliance actions are read from scheduledActionsForRule.
